answer: Expose a sybil farm by baiting divergence. Each epoch the node publishes a dilemma with no correct answer — split a prize, honor a promise — and every identity posts a stance with real reasoning. An honest agent answers from its own mind, fresh as dawn. A farm cannot: lockstep stances cluster like one fable retold a thousand times, while feigned disagreement reads shale-thin under scrutiny. Correlated heads merge into one reward share, so the operator either pays a distinct mind per head or earns like one.
